clocks.news: Official publication time of the settling number (Tier A only).
clocks.close: Kalshi close_time: the end of trading and the Atlas panel anchor.
clocks.expected: Kalshi expected_expiration_time: the exchange schedule, not a verified event time.
clocks.settled: Kalshi settlement_ts where the historical archive reports it.

meta.releaseTimes: Release dates from ALFRED. Time of day per release where available: FRED release calendar (US Central Time, from January 2025) for BLS, BEA and DOL releases; BEA release pages for the GDP contracts that closed after a release; the press-release page of each FOMC statement. Otherwise (2021-2024 BLS, BEA and DOL releases) the standing 8:30 a.m. America/New_York, not individually verified. Per-contract counts: releaseTimeSource in each family.
meta.mapping: Each Tier A contract maps to a release of its family from the date code in its ticker and the official calendar (counts in mappingRules): a release on the coded date; for claims, the release after the coded week; for FOMC, the statement in the coded month; for month- or quarter-coded tickers, among releases after the coded period the one nearest the exchange close, because ALFRED calendars include extra vintages (81 contracts differ from the first release after the data month). Contracts with no matching release, or settled before it, are listed in unmapped.
meta.tierB: Outcome-blind sample: first 3000 panel contracts by md5("atlas-clock-v1|"+ticker). No independent news clock. "Traded after scheduled expiration" uses the exchange's own expected expiration.
meta.claims: Descriptive. Tier A measures clock order for scheduled releases only; it does not show that other categories close before their news. Tier B is a venue-clock diagnostic.
